questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Adobe and Topaz Labs are close competitors in the supply of photo and video enhancement software and there are not many alternatives, or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.

Who do you consider to be the key providers of AI-based photo and video enhancement tools, and what are the differentiating factors between these providers? Do you consider tools that are offered by suppliers as part of a broader product suite (such as those from Bytedance, OpenAI, and Google) as alternatives to dedicated AI-based photo and video enhancement software (such as Topaz Labs)?
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Adobe and/or Topaz Labs.
